review_method: Opened and visually inspected all four final rendered PNGs.
observations: Clean slender double-sided five-level gondola; front and rear stock visible across the four views.
Plain boxes, rolled can seams and puffy sealed bags read as distinct shapes.
Muted ivory, teal, ochre, terracotta and sage match recent mall display fixtures.
Blank end signs and rails; no brand marks or readable text.

initial_issue.detail: First side preview showed coplanar end-sign faces with flicker/black patches.
initial_issue.correction: Moved sign backing 1 mm inward; regenerated and reviewed all final previews.
